scope: Concrete audio lifecycle and OS resume-permission fixes. Not full Apple audio/runtime acceptance.
implemented: Initial activity derives from UIApplication state; every physical start checks owned/current activity and active interruption. No eager audio-session activation at manager initialization.
Main-queue notifications update the MainActor synchronously rather than queuing stale Task state. Resignation immediately stops physical playback while preserving eligible logical loop requests.
Foreground restores all explicitly owned categories, including effect loops, respecting disabled/muted/suspended channel state. One-shots are never restored as loops.

OS interruption-ended handling honors shouldResume. Denied automatic resume holds channels until fresh channel-specific loop or explicit control intent; foreground/one-shot activity cannot release held music.

Existing Settings toggle bindings update the same persisted values and explicitly release the appropriate held channel; global unmute can release all eligible channels. Volume/artwork/recordings/keys unchanged.
